blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dense optical flow allows small drones to avoid obstacles. However, few dense optical flow networks are designed for microcontrollers (MCUs) with neural accelerators, whose on-chip SRAM limits the input resolution. We present PACE-NAS, a macro-to-micro neural architecture search framework that decouples memory from latency: a macro design fixes the backbone and its peak SRAM, and a micro design searches operators and depths to trade accuracy against compiler-estimated latency. We apply it to EdgeFlowNet on a Grove Vision AI V2 board (Ethos-U55), where profiling locates the peak SRAM at the full-resolution output head. Replacing transposed convolutions with bilinear upsampling and convolutions lowers the peak SRAM by 18%, and two lightweight context modules lower the endpoint error (EPE) without raising the peak. All searched subnets share this peak, so the search needs no memory constraint. We name the Pareto-optimal models MCUFlowNet; the fastest variant, MCUFlowNet-S, runs 1.76x faster than a retrained EdgeFlowNet at a 1.6% higher EPE and, in simulated forest flights at 2 m/s, reaches the goal without collision in 51.5% of trials, against 41.8%. PACE-NAS also applies to semantic segmentation, where a searched PIDNet-S variant runs 1.17x faster at similar accuracy. Code is available at https://gitlab.kuleuven.be/emedia-research-lab/esat-stadius/mcuflownet/mcuflownet.
blocks.zh: ense光学流使得小型无人机能够避开障碍. 然而,很少为带有神经加速器的微控制器(MCU)设计密集的光学流网,其上芯SRAM限制了输入分辨率. 我们提出PACE-NAS,一个宏观到微观神经结构的搜索框架,将内存与耐久性脱钩:宏观设计修复主干及其峰值SRAM,以及一个微观设计搜索操作员和深度,以交易精确度与编译器估计的耐久性. 我们把它应用到EdgeFlowNet上的Grove Vision AI V2板(Ethos-U55)上,在全分辨率输出头处的剖面定位最高峰SRAM. 用双线式升标和缩标来取代转录式转录,将峰值SRAM降低18%,两个轻量级上下文模块在不提升峰值的情况下降低端点错误(EPE). 所有被搜索的子网都共享这个峰值,因此搜索不需要内存约束. 我们把Pareto-优化模型命名为MCUFlowNet;最快的变体MCUFlowNet-S运行速度比重新训练的EdgeFlowNet快1.6%,在模拟森林飞行中,每秒2米,在51.5%的试验中达到目标,比41.8%。 PACE-NAS也适用于语义分解,其中被搜索的PIDNet-S变体运行速度更快,精度相似. 代码见https://gitlab.kuleuven.be/emedia-research-lab/esat-stadius/mcuflownet/mcuflownet.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Small aerial robots rely on timely dense optical flow, the per-pixel displacement between consecutive frames, for collision avoidance [ 1 ] , and on optical flow for autonomous landing and self-motion estimation [ 2 ] .
Perception delay shortens the time available to avoid obstacles [ 3 ] , which motivates onboard processing [ 4 ] , and strict weight and power budgets favor microcontrollers (MCUs) [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh:
小型航空机器人依赖于及时的密集光学流,相接相框相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
感知延迟会缩短可以避免障碍的时间[3],这激励了机上处理[4],严格的重量和动力预算有利于微控制器(MCU)[5].

blocks.en:
EdgeFlowNet, a compact multi-scale network of standard convolutions, brings dense optical flow to the Coral Edge TPU [ 6 ] , but on MCUs its full-resolution output head sets the peak SRAM and thus bounds the input resolution.
Hardware-aware neural architecture search (NAS) adapts networks to a target device [ 7 ] ; on MCUs, it treats peak SRAM as a constraint and can be co-designed with the memory scheduling of the inference engine [ 8 , 9 ] .
For optical flow, however, NAS has typically targeted GPU-scale models [ 10 ] , and few dense flow networks are designed for MCUs with neural accelerators.
blocks.zh:
EdgeFlowNet是一个紧凑的多尺度标准演化网络,它给珊瑚边缘TPU带来了密集的光学流[6],但在MCU上它的全分辨率输出头设置了峰值SRAM并从而将输入分辨率相接.
硬件-意识神经架构搜索(NAS)将网络适应目标设备[7];在MCU上,它将峰值SRAM视为一种约束,可以与推论引擎的内存调度[8,9]共同设计.
然而对于光学流,NAS通常针对GPU尺度模型[10],很少为带有神经加速器的MCU设计出密集流网.

blocks.en:
This paper proposes PACE-NAS, a macro-to-micro framework for hardware-aware NAS that adapts existing dense flow networks to MCUs by decoupling memory from latency (Fig. 1 ).
Its macro design profiles the target platform, restructures the layers that set the peak SRAM, and adds two lightweight context modules for image-wide context where SRAM is spare; these steps fix the backbone and its peak SRAM.
Its micro design trains a weight-sharing supernet over operators and depths that leave this peak unchanged, then runs an evolutionary Pareto search over endpoint error (EPE) and the latency estimated by Arm’s Vela compiler [ 11 ] .
To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to use hardware-aware NAS to design dense optical flow networks for MCUs.
blocks.zh:
本文提出PACE-NAS,是硬件意识NAS的宏观到微观框架,通过将内存与后置脱钩来使现有的密集流网适应MCU(图一.
它的宏设计剖析了目标平台,重组了设置峰值SRAM的地层,并增加了两个轻量级上下文模块,用于没有SRAM的全图像上下文;这些步骤固定了主干及其峰值SRAM.
它的微观设计在操作员和深度上训练出一个权重共享超级网,使这一峰值保持不变,然后在端点错误(EPE)和由Arm's Vela编译器估计的耐久性上运行进化的Pareto搜索.
据我们所知,这是第一个使用有硬件意识的NAS为MCU设计密集光学流网的工作.

blocks.en:
On Grove Vision AI V2, a board with an Arm Cortex-M55 MCU and an Ethos-U55 accelerator, we apply PACE-NAS to EdgeFlowNet and retrain two Pareto-optimal subnets, which we call MCUFlowNet-S and MCUFlowNet-L.
Both our models need less peak SRAM than a retrained EdgeFlowNet; MCUFlowNet-S is 1.76 × \times faster at a 1.6% higher EPE, while MCUFlowNet-L matches EdgeFlowNet’s latency at a similar EPE.
Mainly because of its lower latency, MCUFlowNet-S also raises the success rate in simulated obstacle avoidance from 41.8% to 51.5%.
On semantic segmentation, PACE-NAS finds a faster PIDNet-S at similar accuracy.
blocks.zh:
在Grove Vision AI V2上,一个带有Arm Cortex-M55MCU和Ethos-U55加速器的板子上,我们将PACE-NAS应用到EdgeFlowNet,并重新训练出两个Pareto-优化子网,我们称之为MCUFlowNet-S和MCUFlowNet-L.
我们的两种模型都需要的峰值SRAM都比重新训练的EdgeFlowNet少;MCUFlowNet-S在1.6%的EPE中速度快,而MCUFlowNet-L与EdgeFlowNet在类似EPE中的空档相匹配.
主要由于其低潜性,MCUFlowNet-S还将模拟障碍避去的成功率从41.8%提高到了51.5%。
在语义分解方面,PACE-NAS以相近的精度发现了更快的PIDNet-S.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Accurate optical flow networks typically run on GPUs: RAFT refines flow recurrently from all-pairs correlations [ 12 ] , and NeuFlow v2 reaches real-time operation on embedded GPUs with coarse global matching and lightweight recurrent updates [ 13 ] .
Lighter pyramid networks estimate flow from coarse to fine: SPyNet warps one frame toward the other at each level and predicts a residual flow [ 14 ] , and FastFlowNet adds a compact cost volume, which stores matching costs between features of the two frames [ 15 ] .
On MCUs, classical block matching has been accelerated with multicore parallelism [ 16 ] , and NanoFlowNet runs on GAP8 with depthwise separable convolutions [ 1 ] .
EdgeFlowNet instead uses an encoder–decoder of standard convolutions, without cost volumes or warping, and accumulates flow increments predicted at three scales [ 6 ] ; all its operators run on the Ethos-U55, so we build on EdgeFlowNet.
blocks.zh:
精准光学流网一般运行在GPU上:RAFT从全等相通性上不断精炼流出[12],而NeuFlow v2在嵌入式GPU上实现实时运行,并有粗糙的全球匹配和轻量级的经常性更新[13].
更轻的金字塔网络估算出从粗到细的流量:SPyNet一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向一帧向后,FastFlowNet则会增加一个紧凑的成本量,它存储两个帧特征相匹配的成本[15].
在MCU上,古典区块比对被加速了多核平行主义[16],而NanoFlowNet运行于GAP8上并有深度可分分化的相接性[1].
EdgeFlowNet转而使用一个标准编解码器-标准编解码器,没有成本量或扭曲,并积累了在三个尺度 [6] 上预测的流量递增;其所有运营商运行在Ethos-U55上,所以我们建立在EdgeFlowNet上.

blocks.en:
NAS has not yet been applied to dense optical flow on MCUs: FlowNAS searches optical flow encoders for GPU-scale models under a parameter budget [ 10 ] , and multi-objective zero-shot NAS returns a Pareto set for image classification [ 17 ] .
NAS on MCUs has targeted classification and detection, where peak SRAM also depends on how the inference engine schedules layers in memory. MCUNet first fits its search space to the memory budget, then searches within it and co-designs the inference engine [ 8 ] ; MCUNetV2 jointly searches networks and patch schedules to lower peak SRAM, at the cost of recomputing overlapping features [ 9 ] .
Like MCUNet, PACE-NAS designs before it searches, but it first lowers peak SRAM by restructuring the backbone and then searches only choices that leave this peak unchanged, so the search needs no memory constraint.
blocks.zh:
NAS尚未应用于MCU的密集光学流: FlowNAS在参数预算下搜索GPU比例模型的光学流编码器[10],多目标零发NAS返回一个Pareto集用于图像分类[17].
MCU上的NAS有针对性地分类和检测,其中峰值SRAM也取决于内存中的推论引擎时间表层. MCUNet首先将其搜索空间与内存预算相匹配,然后在内部进行搜索并共同设计推论引擎 [8];MCUNetV2联合搜索网络并补丁时间表以降低峰值SRAM,代价是重编重叠特性 [9].
和MCUNet一样,PACE-NAS在搜索之前的设计,但是它首先通过重组主干线来降低峰值SRAM,然后只搜索使得这一峰值保持不变的选择,因此搜索不需要内存约束.

blocks.en: III PACE-NAS: A Macro-to-Micro Design Framework
blocks.zh: 三. PACE-NAS:宏观对微观设计框架

blocks.en:
Fig. 1 outlines the four steps of PACE-NAS: platform profiling (P) and architectural restructuring (A) form the macro design, which fixes the backbone and its peak SRAM; supernet training over a configuration space (C) and evolutionary Pareto search (E) form the micro design.
Fig. 2 shows the resulting backbone for optical flow; the search changes only its 11 searchable boxes.
blocks.zh:
图一概述了PACE-NAS的四个步骤:平台剖析(P)和建筑结构调整(A)组成了宏设计,它固定了主干及其峰值SRAM;超网训练在一个配置空间(C)和进化派雷托搜索(E)上形成微观设计.
图2显示了由此产生的光学流的骨干;搜索只改变其11个可搜索的框.

blocks.en: III-A Platform Profiling and Bottleneck Diagnostics (P)
blocks.zh: 三-A 平台剖析和博特伦克诊断(P)

blocks.en: On Grove Vision AI V2, firmware and frame buffers leave 1434 KiB of SRAM available for the tensor arena holding intermediate tensors. Fig. 3 presents per-stage Vela profiles of EdgeFlowNet in 8-bit integer (INT8) precision at 160 × 208 160\times 208 , before and after restructuring: before, the peak SRAM reaches 1430 KiB at the full-resolution output head (top), only 4 KiB below the available budget. This peak arises because the head must hold its upsampled input and its output simultaneously. Together, this head and the transposed convolution feeding it also account for about 40% of the estimated cycles, so we target the transposed convolutions for restructuring.
blocks.zh: 在Grove Vision AI V2上,坚固的软件和帧缓冲器留下了1434个SRAM的KiB,可供持有中间伸缩器的拉诺竞技场使用. 图3以8位整数(INT8)的精度,以160×208 160\times 208的精度,在重组前和重组后呈现出每阶段Vela剖面:在重组之前,SRAM的峰值在全分辨率输出头(上)会达到1430KiB,只有4KiB低于可用预算. 出现这一峰值是因为头部必须同时保持其被检测出的投入和输出. 这个头部和移植的进化体 也占了估计周期的40% 所以我们把移植的进化体 用于重组

blocks.en: III-B Architectural Restructuring (A)
blocks.zh: 三-B 建筑结构调整(A)

blocks.en:
Vela 4.5.0 can cascade compatible layers (e.g., convolutions), computing them stripe by stripe so that the feature maps between them are never stored whole, but it does not cascade transposed convolutions [ 11 ] .
We therefore replace all 11 transposed convolutions with standard convolutions of the same kernel size and insert a bilinear × 2 \times 2 resize before each of the four former stride-2 layers ( ↑ \uparrow 2 in Fig. 2 ), but keep EdgeFlowNet’s coarse-to-fine accumulation of flow increments.
The peak then moves to final flow upsampling (Flow accum. in Fig. 3 ), and the restructured backbone fits a 172 × 224 172\times 224 input, at which EdgeFlowNet exceeds the tensor arena.
blocks.zh:
Vela 4.5.0可以级联相容地层(如相接地层),用条纹来计算它们,这样它们之间的地物图就永远不会被完整地存储,但不会级联相接地层相接地层[11].
因此,我们用相同内核大小的标准演化来取代所有11个转接的演化,并在前4个阶地平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面平面
然后峰值移动到最后的流量向上采样(Flow accum. in Fig. 3),重组后的主干能适应172×224 172\times 224输入,其中EdgeFlowNet超过了收音机竞技场.

blocks.en:
Because each convolution sees only a local window [ 18 ] , we use the spare SRAM in the early stages (Fig. 3 ) to add image-wide context before flow prediction.
Efficient channel attention (ECA) [ 19 ] reweights the channels of the lowest-resolution feature, at 1 / 16 1/16 of the input resolution (DB0 in Fig. 2 ), where features carry broad spatial context and the tensor is small.
A global broadcast gate adapted from squeeze-and-excitation [ 18 ] then uses this context to modulate the 1 / 4 1/4 decoder feature, which feeds all three flow heads (Fig. 2 ).

blocks.en: III-C Configuration Space and Supernet Training (C)
blocks.zh: III-C 配置空间和超级网培训(C)

blocks.en:
The configuration space of PACE-NAS (Fig. 2 ) covers convolutional operators and residual-block depths and fixes connections, channel counts, upsamplers, ECA, and the gate.
It contains no depthwise convolutions: on the Ethos-U55, 3 × 3 3\times 3 depthwise convolutions reach at most about 10% of peak throughput, whereas standard 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions exceed 90% once channel counts reach 32 [ 20 ] .
Unlike channel counts, its choices leave tensor sizes unchanged and change only layers that need less SRAM than final flow upsampling, where the peak lies; no subnet can raise the peak, so the search needs no memory constraint (Section IV-B ).
blocks.zh:
PACE-NAS(图2)的配置空间包括了革命操作员和剩余区块的深度并固定连接,通道计数,上升取样员,ECA和大门.
它不包含有深层分解:在Ethos-U55上,3×3 3相深层分解最多达到最高吞吐量的10%左右,而标准3×3 3相深层分解在频道计数后超过90%[20].
与频道计数不同的是,其选择保留了收音机大小不变,仅改变需要较少SRAM的地层,而非最终流上取样,峰值所在;没有子网可以提升峰值,因此搜索不需要内存约束(第四节-B.

blocks.en:
E0 and E1 each choose among three convolutional operators, which set the spatial context passed downstream; EB0, EB1, DB0, and DB1 each hold one to three residual blocks, which set capacity across scales; and each of the five costly high-resolution head convolutions uses a 3 × 3 3\times 3 or 5 × 5 5\times 5 kernel for local context (Fig. 2 ).
Together, these choices give 3 6 × 2 5 = 23,328 3^{6}\times 2^{5}=23{,}328 subnets.
blocks.zh:
E0和E1各自选择三个回旋操作器,这些回旋操作器设置了从下游经过的空间上下文;EB0,EB1,DB0和DB1各持有一到三个剩余块,这些块会设定跨尺度的容量;而五个昂贵的高分辨率头回旋器中,每个回旋器都使用3×3相3相3相3相5相5相5相5相5相5相5相内核作为局部上下文(图2).
这些选择加在一起,给出了3个6×2 5 = 23,328 3^{6}\times 2^{5}=23{,}328子网.

blocks.en:
We train a weight-sharing supernet on FlyingChairs2 (FC2) [ 21 ] by sampling single paths, as in Single Path One-Shot (SPOS) [ 22 ] .
Because subnets are scored with these shared weights instead of being retrained, we use FairNAS-inspired balanced sampling [ 23 ] to give competing operators comparable training exposure.
Because the paths share weights, each sampled path pulls the shared layers toward its own features during supernet training [ 10 ] . We therefore add FlowNAS’s feature alignment distillation to the multi-scale flow and uncertainty losses [ 6 ] : at corresponding layers, every path learns to match a frozen EdgeFlowNet teacher, so all paths move toward the same features.
blocks.zh:
我们通过单一路径取样在飞行会长2 (FC2)[21]上培训一个分量的超级网络,如在单一路径一放(SPOS)[22]中。
因为子网是用这些共享的权重来打分而不是重新训练,所以我们使用FairNAS所启发的平衡采样[23]来给相竞争的操作者提供相类似的训练曝光.
由于路径共享权重,每个被采样的路径都会将共享的地层拉入自己在超网训练中的特征[10]. 因此,我们将FlowNAS的特性相接分解加入到多尺度的流量和不确定性损失中 [6] : 在相应的层次上,每条路径都学会匹配一个被冻结的EdgeFlowNet老师,因此所有路径都朝着相同的特征发展.

blocks.en: III-D Evolutionary Pareto Search and Model Selection (E)
blocks.zh: III-D 进化派雷托搜索和模型选择(英)

blocks.en:
As in SPOS, we score each subnet by its FC2 validation EPE with inherited supernet weights (supernet EPE) and by the latency that Vela estimates from its exported INT8 graph.
NSGA-II [ 24 ] then searches for the EPE–latency Pareto front.
From this front, we retrain two subnets from scratch and deploy them in INT8 (Section IV ): MCUFlowNet-S, the fastest, and MCUFlowNet-L, the closest to EdgeFlowNet in Vela-estimated latency at 172 × 224 172\times 224 , for an equal-latency comparison.
blocks.zh:
与SPOS一样,我们通过FC2验证EPE对每个子网的分数进行继承的超网权重(Supernet EPE)和Vela从其输出的INT8图中估计的分数.
NSGA-II [24] 然后搜索EPE -lentency Pareto前线.
从这个角度出发,我们从零开始重新培训两个子网,并将其部署在INT8(第四节):MCUFlowNet-S,速度最快;MCUFlowNet-L,距离EdgeFlowNet最接近,在Vela估计的延迟为172×224172\tims 224,进行等效比较.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 四. 实验评价

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: The supernet is trained on FC2 at 172 × 224 172\times 224 for 200 epochs, after which NSGA-II evaluates 800 of the 23,328 subnets; together, these take an estimated 17 H200 GPU-hours, about half of one full EdgeFlowNet training run (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 超级网以172×224172\times224对200个时代进行FC2训练,之后NSGA-II对23,328个子网中的800个进行了评价;这些加起来估计需要17个H200GPU小时,大约是EdgeFlowNet全程训练运行的一半(图一.

blocks.en:
For Table III , we train MCUFlowNet-S, MCUFlowNet-L, and EdgeFlowNet from scratch at 160 × 208 160\times 208 , the largest input at which EdgeFlowNet fits the tensor arena, with the same recipe: 400 epochs on FC2, then 10k steps on random FC2 crops resized to the input and 80k steps on a 3:1 mix of FC2 crops and FlyingThings3D (FT3D) frames [ 25 ] .
For every model trained on FT3D, we keep the checkpoint with the lowest FT3D validation EPE.
Test EPE is computed on all pairs of the Final pass of the MPI-Sintel training set [ 26 ] at its central 416 × 1024 416\times 1024 crop, without clipping large ground-truth displacements; deployed models see resized inputs, and their outputs are rescaled to the crop.
The deployed models are quantized post-training to INT8 with 64 FC2 calibration pairs and compiled with Vela 4.5.0 for an Ethos-U55 with 64 multiply–accumulate (MAC) units at 400 MHz.
Latencies in Tables III and IV are measured on the board with TensorFlow Lite Micro [ 27 ] , excluding image capture and pre- and post-processing.
blocks.zh:
就表三而言,我们从零开始对MCUFlowNet-S、MCUFlowNet-L和EdgeFlowNet进行160×208160\times 208的训练,这是EdgeFlowNet符合收音机竞技场的最大投入,配有相同的食谱:FC2上的400个历程,然后对FC2随机作物调整为收音机的10克步,FC2作物和FlyingThings3D(FT3D)帧的3:1组合上的80克步.
每一个FT3D训练的型号, 我们保留检查点 最低FT3D验证EPE。
在MPI-Sintel训练集的416 × 1024 416\times 1024作物的中点[26]最后通过的所有对子上计算测试ETE,不剪接大面积地上真值移位;部署的模型见重排输入量,其输出量被调整为作物.
所部署的型号为64个FC2校正对分解后分解为INT8,并用Vela 4.5.0编译Ethos-U55型,在400兆赫时有64个乘积(MAC)单元。
表三和表四中的后期用TensorFlow Lite Micro来测量板上,不包括图像捕捉和前后处理.

blocks.en: IV-B Macro Design Sets Memory, Search Allocates Latency
blocks.zh: IV-B 宏设计设置内存, 搜索分配空档

blocks.en:
Table I ablates the macro-design components on EdgeFlowNet: the restructured decoder, ECA, and the gate.
At 172 × 224 172\times 224 , restructuring reduces the Vela-estimated peak SRAM by 18%, to fit within the tensor arena, and latency by 15%, while the mean EPE changes by less than one standard deviation.
ECA and the gate each lower EPE for every seed.
Together they add 0.9% Vela-estimated latency without raising peak SRAM, and MCUFlowNet keeps both.
blocks.zh:
表一列出EdgeFlowNet上的宏观设计组件:经调整的解码器、非洲经委会和大门。
在172×224 172\时224,重组将Vela估计的峰值SRAM减少18%,以适应于收音机竞技场,而耐久性则减少15%,而平均的ETE变化不到一个标准差.
非洲经委会和大门每根种子每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分每分
加上0.9%的Vela估计耐用性,

blocks.en: TABLE I: Decoder ablation on EdgeFlowNet trained on FC2 and FT3D at 352 × 480 352\times 480 : FP32 Sintel Final EPE (mean ± \pm SD, three seeds) and Vela estimates at 172 × 224 172\times 224 .
blocks.zh: 表格 I: EdgeFlowNet上的解码器被以352×480352\times 480对FC2和FT3D进行训练:FP32 Sintel Final EPE(意为 ±\pm SD,3个种子)和Vela估计以172×224172\times 224.

blocks.en:
All 800 evaluated subnets share the same peak SRAM but span 2.19 × 2.19\times in Vela-estimated latency, so the macro design alone sets the peak, and the search only decides where to spend latency.
On the Ethos-U55, latency is better spent on depth at low resolution than on large high-resolution kernels such as EdgeFlowNet’s.
An extra residual block at 1 / 8 1/8 or 1 / 16 1/16 resolution adds 9–24 ms and lowers the supernet EPE by 0.08–0.21 px, whereas a 5 × 5 5\times 5 instead of a 3 × 3 3\times 3 kernel at H1 or H2 adds about 12 ms but lowers it by only 0.001–0.002 px.
Accordingly, 50 of the 51 Pareto-optimal subnets use 3 × 3 3\times 3 kernels at H1 and H2, and MCUFlowNet-L spends 95% of its extra latency over MCUFlowNet-S on these low-resolution residual blocks.
Vela’s latency estimates are reliable for the search: on the board, all deployed models run within 2.1% of their estimates.
blocks.zh:
所有800个被评价的子网都共享同一峰值SRAM,但跨度为 2.19 × 2.19\times in Vela - 估计的空闲时间,因此仅宏观设计就设定了峰值,而搜索只决定了空闲时间的用地.
在Ethos-U55上,低分辨率的潜伏性比EdgeFlowNet等大型高分辨率内核更能用于深度.
额外的剩余块以 1 / 8 1/8 或 1 / 16 1/16 分辨率增加 9–24 ms 并降低超网 EPE 0.08–0.21 px,而一个 5 × 5 5\tims 5 而不是 3 × 3 3\tims 3 内核在 H1 或 H2 上增加约 12 ms ,但只降低 0.001–0.002 px.
因此,51个Pareto-优化子网中有50个在H1和H2使用3×3 3\times 3内核,而MCUFlowNet-L在这些低分辨率残块上花费了95%的额外闲置时间来使用MCUFlowNet-S.
Vela的延迟估计对于搜索是可靠的:在董事会上,所有部署的模型都运行在估计值的2.1%。

blocks.en: IV-C MCUFlowNet Runs Faster or as Fast at Similar EPE
blocks.zh: 四-C 聚氯氟烃 网络运行更快, 或在类似的 ETE 中快速运行

blocks.en:
Table II reports MCUFlowNet and published FP32 optical flow models with public weights.
Models with cost volumes or warping reach the lowest EPEs, but in our tests none of them, not even FastFlowNet and SPyNet with the fewest parameters, could be deployed on the MCU.
Compared with EdgeFlowNet, MCUFlowNet-S lowers the EPE by 17% at a similar MAC count, and MCUFlowNet-L by 29% with 1.5 × \times the MACs.
blocks.zh:
表二报告MCUFlowNet,并公布了带有公众权重的FP32光学流模型.
具有成本量或扭曲的模型达到最低的ETE,但在我们的测试中,没有任何一个,甚至没有最少数参数的FastFlowNet和SPyNet可以部署在MCU上.
与EdgeFlowNet相比,MCUFlowNet-S在相似的MAC计分中将EPE降低17%,而MCUFlowNet-L则在1.5×x\x时将MAC降低29%.

blocks.zh: 表二:MPI-Sintel训练集最终通关时的FP32光学流线模型:416×1024 4.16分秒 1024 (英语). 重迭数列于括号内。

blocks.en:
Table III reports the deployed INT8 models on the board. Our recipe reduces the EPE of EdgeFlowNet by 20% relative to its public weights, so we compare against this retrained baseline.
At the same input, MCUFlowNet-S runs 1.76 × \times faster at a 1.6% higher EPE, and MCUFlowNet-L matches the baseline’s latency at a similar EPE.
Both MCUFlowNet models need the same peak SRAM, 18% less than EdgeFlowNet, so choosing between them trades only speed against accuracy.
blocks.zh:
表三报告机上部署的INT8型号. 我们的食谱将EdgeFlowNet的EPE相对于其公共权重减少了20%,因此我们比较了这个重新训练的基线.
在同样的投入中,MCUFlowNet-S运行1.76×x\时间速度快于1.6%的EPE,而MCUFlowNet-L则与基线在类似EPE中的耐用性相匹配.
两者均使用MCUFlow Net模型需要相同的峰值SRAM,比EdgeFlowNet少了18%,因此在它们之间选择只交易速度与精度.

blocks.en: TABLE III: INT8 models on Grove Vision AI V2 at 160 × 208 160\times 208 . SRAM: Vela-estimated peak. SR and Coll.: success rate and collisions per trial over the same 194 simulated trials for every model, at 2 m/s.
blocks.zh: 表三:Grove Vision AI V2上的INT8型号为160×208160\times 208. (原始内容存档于2018-09-26). SRAM: Vela-assigned 峰值. SR和Col.:每个模型在相同的194个模拟试验中,每次试验的成功率和相撞率为2米/秒。

blocks.en: IV-D Lower Latency Improves Obstacle Avoidance
blocks.zh: IV-D 低延迟改进障碍避免

blocks.en:
We fly a simulated quadrotor through the AvoidBench forest [ 28 ] at 2 m/s; a trial succeeds if the quadrotor reaches the goal without collision.
As in EdgeFlowNet [ 6 ] , the controller steers toward free space near the goal direction.
All flow models share this controller, and each steering update waits for the model’s Vela-estimated latency plus link and frame delays.
MCUFlowNet-S succeeds more often than the retrained EdgeFlowNet (51.5% against 41.8%; Table III ).
When slowed to the steering interval of the retrained EdgeFlowNet, it succeeds in only 43.8% of trials and collides about as often as the baseline (0.91 against 0.92 per trial), so most of this gain comes from its lower latency, which lets the quadrotor react to obstacles earlier.
At EdgeFlowNet’s latency, MCUFlowNet-L and the two EdgeFlowNet models succeed in 41.8% to 45.4% of trials whatever their EPE (6.36 to 8.03 px), so in this task latency matters more than EPE.
blocks.zh:
我们以2米/秒的速度通过"避免奔驰"森林飞出一个模拟的四相星;如果四相星没有相撞地到达目标,试飞成功.
如同EdgeFlowNet [6] 中,控制器向目标方向附近的自由空间方向行驶.
所有流线模型都共享这个控制器,每个方向盘更新都会等待模型的Vela估计的延迟加链接和帧延迟.
聚氟乙烯 Net-S的成功频率高于重新培训的EdgeFlowNet(51.5%对41.8%;表三)。
当减速到再训练的EdgeFlowNet的引导间隔时,它只成功43.8%的试验和碰撞,大约与基线一样频繁(0.91比0.92每场试验),所以这一收益大部分来自它的低潜,这使得四轮驱动器对更早的障碍作出反应.
在边缘花 Net的耐用性,MCUFlowNet-L和两个EdgeFlowNet模型在无论EPE(6.36到8.03 px)的试验中以41.8%到45.4%的成绩成功,因此在这项任务中耐用性比EPE更重要。

blocks.en: IV-E Generalization to Segmentation
blocks.zh: 四-E 一般化为分块

blocks.en: Beyond optical flow, we apply PACE-NAS to PIDNet-S [ 29 ] on Cityscapes [ 30 ] at a 160 × 320 160\times 320 input, at which PIDNet-S already peaks at 1350 KiB, 84 KiB below the tensor arena, so the macro design skips restructuring and adds only ECA and the gate. The configuration space covers the number of residual blocks in each of the seven stages and, in six of them, the second-convolution kernel size ( 3 × 3 3\times 3 or 5 × 5 5\times 5 ) of every block after the first. NSGA-II evaluates 960 of the 1.41 million subnets by INT8 mean intersection over union (mIoU) on the validation images and by Vela-estimated latency. All models start from the same ImageNet weights and use the official recipe with training views cropped from the full-resolution image, as for optical flow; we train three seeds per model and quantize them post-training with 256 training images. From the Pareto front, we retrain an accurate subnet and the subnets faster than PIDNet-S; Table IV reports three of them: a fast, a balanced, and an accurate subnet.
blocks.zh: 除了光学流外,我们还将PACE-NAS应用于Cityscapes上的PIDNet-S [29] 在160×320 160\times 320输入中,PIDNet-S已经以1350 KiB,84 KiB低于收音机竞技场为高峰,所以宏观设计跳过重组,只添加了ECA和大门. 配置空间覆盖了7个阶段中每个阶段的剩余块数,在其中6个阶段中,第1个阶段后每个块的第二演化内核大小(3×3 3等分3等分5等分5等分5等分). NSGA-II通过INT8在验证图像和由Vela估计的延缓性上的平均相交点(mIoU)来评价141万个子网中的960个. 所有模型都从相同的ImageNet重量开始,使用正式的食谱,从全分辨率图像中抽取培训视图,如光学流;我们每个模型培训出3个种子,并在培训后用256个培训图像加以量化。 从Pareto战线,我们重新训练一个准确的子网和比PIDNet-S快的子网;表四报告了其中三个:快活,平衡,准确的子网.

blocks.en: TABLE IV: INT8 segmentation on Grove Vision AI V2 at 160 × 320 160\times 320 (500 Cityscapes validation images; mean over three seeds, ± \pm SD for mIoU); all models peak at 1350 KiB.
blocks.zh: 表四:Grove Vision AI V2上的INT8分取160×320 160\times 320 (500 Cityscapes验证图像;意为3个以上种子,±\pm SD for mIoU;所有模型最高峰为1350 KiB.

blocks.en:
Adding ECA and the gate raises the mean mIoU of the retrained PIDNet-S slightly, by 0.2 points (Table IV ).
Relative to the retrained PIDNet-S, the fast subnet trades 1.0 point of mIoU for a 1.36 × \times speedup, the balanced subnet matches its mIoU (+0.04 points on average) with a 1.17 × \times speedup, and the accurate subnet gains only 0.6 points, about one standard deviation, at 6% higher latency.
The search can thus trade off accuracy against latency on segmentation as well.
blocks.zh:
加上非洲经委会和大门使重新训练的PIDNet-S的平均MIOU略高了0.2分(表四)。
相对于再训练的PIDNet-S,快子网以1.36×\times的加速度交易mIoU的1.0分,平衡子网以1.17×\times的加速度与其mIoU(平均+0.04分)相匹配,而准确子网只得到0.6分,大约一个标准差,高6%的分.
因此,这种搜寻也可以与分化的暂时性相交换。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
PACE-NAS treats peak SRAM as a design problem and latency as a search problem.
Profiling (P) locates the layer that sets the peak SRAM, restructuring (A) lowers this peak once, for all subnets, and a configuration space (C) that leaves tensor sizes unchanged keeps it there, so the Pareto search (E) handles only accuracy and latency.
PACE-NAS turns EdgeFlowNet, an existing network designed for the Edge TPU, into MCUFlowNet for the Ethos-U55.
We build two variants, both with 18% less peak SRAM than EdgeFlowNet: against a retrained EdgeFlowNet, MCUFlowNet-S runs 1.76 × \times faster at a 1.6% higher EPE and raises the simulated success rate at 2 m/s from 41.8% to 51.5%, while MCUFlowNet-L matches its latency at a similar EPE.
The search also speeds up PIDNet-S for semantic segmentation by 1.17 × \times at similar mIoU.
blocks.zh:
PACE-NAS将峰值SRAM视为设计上的问题,而后期则视为搜索上的问题.
剖面 (P) 定位设置峰值SRAM的地层,调整 (A) 降低这一峰值一次,对于所有子网来说,一个留有拉伸尺寸的配置空间(C) 保持了它不变,所以Pareto (E) 处理的只是精度和耐久.
PACE-NAS将EdgeFlowNet,一个为Edge TPU所设计的现有网络转变为为Ethos-U55所设计的MCUFlowNet.
我们构建了两种变体,两种变体的峰值SRAM都比EdgeFlowNet少了18%:针对再训练的EdgeFlowNet,MCUFlowNet-S运行速度快于1.6%的EPE,并将模拟成功率从2m/s从41.8%提高到51.5%,而MCUFlowNet-L则在相类似的EPE中与它的纬度相匹配.
搜索还加快了PIDNet-S的语义分解速度,在相近的mIoU上以 1.17 ×\tims.
